about_short_description.short_description: Swayable is a creative testing platform that measures persuasion.

product.name: Creative Pre-testing
product.description: A platform for testing media content's effectiveness in changing opinions, delivering results in under 24 hours without media spend.

product.name: Real Science Impact Tests
product.description: Uses randomized controlled trial (RCT) survey experiments to provide proof of media content's impact on opinions.

product.name: ROI Multiplier
product.description: Insights from the platform can lead to 2X-10X increases in campaign return on investment by informing messaging and media planning.

product.name: Private & Secure
product.description: The platform ensures user consent and complies with global data privacy standards like GDPR and CCPA.
